most_similar_reason: Candidate 1 shares the most distinctive episodes with the target: a culture-hero god who teaches people to sow grain crops and cultivate a fruiting vine, is undone by a rival kinsman, is enclosed and sealed in a box/chest at his death, and is thereafter bound to the underworld and to resurrection/renewal.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 9 is least similar because it contains no narrative at all — no birth, inventions, journey, creation of humanity, or death — merely the bare identification of a deity.
